messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: What is one piece of work from the past year that you are particularly proud of?

messages.speaker: professional
messages.text: I led the requirements work for automating our motor claims intake process.

messages.speaker: professional
messages.text: I ran workshops with claims, fraud and technology teams, mapped the existing process and wrote the functional requirements. I also helped define the API payloads.

messages.speaker: professional
messages.text: The average claim-registration time came down from around 18 minutes to 7 minutes. The solution is now used by about 120 claims handlers.

messages.speaker: professional
messages.text: The first release went live in November 2025.

messages.speaker: professional
messages.text: I also managed the entire engineering team of eight people.

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Was engineering management formally part of your role?

messages.speaker: professional
messages.text: Not exactly. The engineering manager owned the team. I coordinated with them and tracked dependencies.

messages.speaker: professional
messages.text: I recently completed a cloud architecture certification as well.
